family_reports.body: I went to the Frind the court to get help with child support from a man that showed no interest in his child and had a long history of drug abuse. Instead, I had to file bankruptcy borrow money from everybody just to keep my son safe from him after her, ignoring all the evidence. To this day, I still haven’t gotten child support, even though it was ordered, but yet she put my son at risk numerous times. I went to them for help and instead they took away all the safety and security that I had earned on my own. I went for help, instead she destroyed my life.
The family court system victimized my son and myself, while protecting our abuser.

This system has kept my family apart and kept my children from knowing each other and growing up together. The judges and the front of the court need to be held accountable for keeping families apart for no reason other than they don’t wanna do their job and see the evidence.
I no longer believe in people, the courts, or the system. It is not there to help or protect. I have no hope. My beliefs have been shattered. feel broken, a shell of the person I was.

I am a human trafficking survivor and my son was taken by force being trafficked in the system after the referee order for him not to go into foster care! If the Lord did not bless with the 10K, my son would be gone trafficked off in the system from discrimination, having a gentic disorder and lies!

I have been followed, harassed, tracked, mail has been stolen so I didn't show up to a unknown court date, purjuy, alienation, identity theft has occured, my house has been broken into an have been watch, Judge said she would not look at all the evidence of a disabled child being neglected and abused because I am a veteran being accused of dv which never ever happen.

public_comments.comment_text: I had a court order concerning threats being made by my ex. As Pro Se I requested that the court order be fulfilled. I was not allowed to finish going through my motion before Judge Gorcyca allowed the opposing counsel to interrupt me. They both decided that it was 'past the time' for the court order to be fulfilled. Another item, Judge Gorcyca would not follow the JOD. Tutoring was supposed to be paid by both. Even though I had a 2 doctor's stating tutoring was needed for my daughter's dyslexia, I still had to to pay for it by myself. Last, the Judge was supposed to review the evidence in my case. Instead she decided to 'trust' the opposing counsel and not review the evidence. The opposing counsel manipulated the facts to the point one could construe that here statements were false. In her judgement she put me down viciously when all I was doing was trying to get some fairness, and equal treatment by the FOC.
public_comments.author: Anonymous parent

public_comments.comment_text: He ignored everything that she ordered and did not make my ex do it and only me, even though she ordered and threatened him with jail over it she just kept sweeping it under the rock where I finally gave up pressure in it. She said stuff on the record I have court transcripts to prove it even brought them into her to remind her and she pretty much told me too bad. I don’t care what I said previously I’m gonna change it just to make your ex happy for whatever reason it was disgusting I don’t know what she had going on with him, but there was something. He had a lawyer and his lawyer was actually a pretty shady person himself, but he my ex would laugh at me and say that him and the judge were at parties together, so I would never beat him and that he keep getting away with it.
public_comments.author: Anonymous parent

public_comments.comment_text: She pushed my trial 3 time with no explanation. Then stated she was not going to look at all the evidence of a disabled child being abused / neglected by his mother. She signed off and granted the stop of a surgery that our special needs child needs to breath better. Clearly not in the best interest of the child. Not sure. Postponed the trial 3 times now nothing
